analysis: The trial completed successfully but did not improve validation HR@10: macro 0.5063 versus the prior 0.5137 (−0.0074). Electronics fell from 0.410 to 0.385. Other category HR@10 scores were Movies_and_TV 0.555, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.525, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.560. This configuration does not reproduce the historical 0.5375 result. The observed decline does not establish its cause; the added preference branch provided no measured benefit in this trial. Checkpoint and generated-predictor diagnostics completed successfully.
code_summary: SASRec adds a causal uniform preference branch using float32 cumulative means of nonpadding item embeddings within the supplied truncated window, followed by projection and LayerNorm. A feature-wise sigmoid gate blends preference and Transformer features; zero gate weights and bias −2 initially favor the sequential branch. Shared item embeddings, item biases, cross-entropy with 64 sampled negatives, optimizer settings, and all four dataset routes remain intact. Checkpoints strictly reload the added parameters, and the generated predictor imports the matching architecture. Diagnostics cover masked means, empty/singleton histories, causality, finite gradients, and predictor score agreement while preserving RNG state.
